description: Source code implementing AVX512-based compression and decompression of IQ data using brain floating point format (BFP). Contains functions for packing, unpacking, and processing resource blocks with AVX512 intrinsics.

classes.name: iq_compression_bfp_avx512
classes.description: Class providing AVX512 optimized compression and decompression methods for IQ data in brain floating point format.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses IQ data into a buffer using AVX512 intrinsics, supporting resource block processing with exponent calculation and packing.

methods.name: decompress
methods.description: Decompresses IQ data from compressed buffer back into floating point format, using AVX512 instructions for unpacking and scaling.
